summary: Iteration 81 — Tenant business address (Site Mode → map + contact/footer + fallback chain) and chart Source labels (source_label / source_label2). Backend 7/7 pytest PASS on the new suite, iter80 regression 11/11 PASS. Frontend flows all verified: template gallery preview shows the 'Sample address' tag with the template dummy address and no source line; the tenant public site shows the real address (no sample tag) and 'Source: X · Updated <date>' under both charts when set, and NEITHER industry-chart-source nor industry-chart-2-source exists in the DOM when both labels are blank. Site Mode UI: Save disabled until value changes, hint mentions the template sample when address is empty, live-site iframe re-renders with new address + source lines after save. Address trimmed and capped at 160 chars; contact + footer block addresses are updated in place on PUT. Fallback chain confirmed: site_mode.address → contact/footer block → template sample (never blank).
critical_code_review_comments: case_study._write_address correctly iterates pages and only touches blocks whose type is contact/footer AND already carry an address prop — safe, idempotent.

PUT /apps/{id}/site-mode trims and clamps address to 160 chars before persist and propagation (case_study.py:261). Empty-string branch is handled: brand_profile.address is set to '' but blocks are intentionally NOT overwritten, so the fallback chain in studio.py can still find a block address (matches the spec).

studio.public_site() resolves address in the exact fallback order: site_mode → brand_profile → block scan → NICHES[template].address. Only blocks shorter than 90 chars are picked to avoid promoting long contact copy — reasonable guard.

industry_vitals.spec_for now always includes source_label/source_label2 as '' so the frontend can rely on their presence; reset endpoint fully removes the tenant vitals doc which correctly clears any custom source labels.
IndustryVitals.LiveChart renders `{testid}-source` only when `source` truthy — clean conditional and formats the date via toLocaleDateString('day/month/year'). Matches spec.

SiteModePanel Save-address button is disabled based on `addr === (sm.address || '')` — works, but also drops the hint 'Showing the template sample for now: …' as soon as sm.address is truthy (verified). One tiny nit (non-blocking): pressing Enter fires patch() but the disabled-check isn't applied so an unchanged Enter still triggers a PUT — harmless because backend is idempotent.
